Change of variables yields actual probability densities qδ=Wδ/δ; the limiting density integrates to one by a sine-square pushforward of uniform phase, so Scheffé yields total variation convergence. Counting complete and incomplete half-periods proves the if-and-only-if b∈(1/2)N resonance. The extracted standalone checker passed symbolic identities and finite diagnostics. value.rationale: For a published two-dimensional chaotic map studied partly as a pseudo-random generator, the one-step distribution induced by uniform seeds near the reciprocal singularity is a natural, mathematically distinct observable. Explicit strong total-variation convergence and phase-dependent statistical independence quantify an exact boundary-layer effect, while the half-integer gain resonances give a sharp universal two-coordinate arcsine law. This is more than reenumerating preimages and avoids attributing cryptographic or stationary-dynamical implications.
